_comment: The onboarding program, as the customer sees it on their instance's Onboarding tab (Allmoxy Onboarding artifact, 2026-11-11). Loaded into ob_phase / ob_step / ob_role / ob_document_type / ob_training_session. Self-build customers skip Phase 3 (Validate).

phases.name: Phase 1: Kick-Off
phases.description: Identify roles and send the documents the build needs.

phases.name: Phase 2: Initial Settings
phases.description: Theme, order settings, pricing tiers, payment gateway and terms, optional custom domain.

phases.name: Phase 3: Validate (10-order proof)
phases.description: Ten real past orders priced in Allmoxy and approved by the customer.

phases.name: Phase 4: Configure
phases.description: Order workflow, triggers, shipping, accounting, API, production lines, team training.

phases.name: Phase 5: Go-Live
phases.description: Soft launch with a few customers, ten live orders, then invite everyone.

roles.name: Project Champion
roles.description: One point of contact. Answers questions and signs off validation orders

roles.name: Owner / Manager
roles.description: Final say on pricing, terms, and go-live. Approves the build

roles.name: Sales
roles.description: Quotes and bids, customer accounts, pricing tiers, and portal access

roles.name: Customer Service
roles.description: Enters and manages orders and answers customers

roles.name: Designer / Drafter
roles.description: Owns the design files (Cabinet Vision, Mozaik) that feed the Importer

roles.name: Production / Operations
roles.description: Runs the floor: partlists, labels, progress, and shipping

roles.name: Catalog Owner
roles.description: Keeps products, options, and pricing current after launch

roles.name: Finance
roles.description: Invoices, deposits, payments, and the accounting sync

roles.name: IT / Integrations
roles.description: Logins, the payment gateway, and connections to other software

documents.name: Product specifications
documents.description: Box lines, door and finish options, modifications, accessories

documents.name: Design software catalog backup
documents.description: Full catalog from Cabinet Vision, Mozaik, Closet Pro, or similar

documents.name: Pricing and price adjustments
documents.description: List pricing, plus tiers or multipliers by customer

documents.name: Current order forms and past orders
documents.description: How customers order today; 20 to 30 past orders

documents.name: Design software job files
documents.description: Example jobs so the import can be matched

documents.name: Cutlist and CNC file samples
documents.description: Builds the partlist pages and the CNC exporter

documents.name: Output pages and exports you use today
documents.description: Invoices, partlists, labels, and exports another system reads

documents.name: Rules and exclusions
documents.description: Combinations not built or warrantied, size limits, disclaimers

documents.name: Supplier and hardware catalogs
documents.description: Hinges, slides, and outside components priced or offered

documents.name: Brand kit
documents.description: Logos, fonts, imagery, form wording, product photos
